title: Away / Home coordination
summary: The owner publishes whether anyone is home; the other project reacts.

owner: When the house goes away → Set Local Boolean ITEM=Away VALUE=True and Set Local Choice ITEM=System_Mode VALUE=Away.
When someone arrives → Set Local Boolean ITEM=Away VALUE=False.
peer: When <Owner>.Away changed (live) fires and <Owner>.Away is 1 and Remote System Is Ready → run the unattended scene.
Guard native variable triggers with Link Is Synchronized.

title: Guesthouse occupancy
summary: The guesthouse publishes occupancy and guest count with a stability window.

owner: When motion/occupancy changes → Set Local Boolean ITEM=Occupied.
When the guest count is set → Set Local Integer ITEM=Guest_Count.
peer: When <Owner>.Occupied changed (live) fires → adjust HVAC/lighting presets; use Shared Item Is Current before acting.

title: Remote light (native companion)
summary: Export one light from the owner and present it natively on the other project.

exports.name: Porch_Light
exports.note: Start view-only; switch to Control allowed after commissioning confirms feedback.

owner: Programming tab → System Link → Export Device: DEVICE=<the light>, NAME=Porch_Light, KIND=light, CONTROL=View only (then Control allowed once verified).
peer: Select Porch_Light_Level on the bridge → Add Companion For Selected Item → bind the new System Link Light in a room.

title: Remote thermostat (feature-gated)
summary: Export a thermostat natively. Requires the THERMOSTAT feature on the pair licence and hardware validation.

exports.name: Hall_Stat
exports.note: Gated: refused until the licence carries THERMOSTAT. Never pushes cached setpoints on restart.

owner: Export Device: KIND=thermostat, CONTROL=View only first.
peer: Add Companion For Selected Item on Hall_Stat_Temperature → System Link Thermostat.

title: Arrival request with result
summary: One project asks the other to prepare the home and waits for an explicit result.

owner: When Request Received fires and <Owner>.Request_1_Routine is Prepare_Home → run the welcome programming, then Report Request Success SLOT=1 RESULT=done.
If it cannot run → Report Request Failure SLOT=1 RESULT=<why>.
peer: On departure → Send Remote Request ROUTINE=Prepare_Home PAYLOAD=guests=2 DEADLINE=300.
When Request Completed fires and Request Slot Status is '1 completed' → announce; when Request Expired fires → notify the dealer (the outcome was not confirmed).

title: Read-only temperature and contact
summary: Share a temperature and a door contact as read-only sensors.

exports.name: Outdoor_Temp
exports.note: Units are carried as Fahrenheit and Celsius fields.

exports.name: Front_Door
exports.note: A contact is a sensor, not an access-control device.

owner: Export Device: KIND=temperature NAME=Outdoor_Temp; Export Device: KIND=contact NAME=Front_Door.
peer: Add Companion For Selected Item on each; bind the Temperature and Contact companions.

title: Gate request with actual feedback
summary: Open a gate remotely through a request, and confirm with the gate's own position feedback.

ownerItems.name: Gate_Open
ownerItems.description: Actual gate position from its sensor

exports.name: Gate_Relay
exports.note: Pulse only (ops=trigger). Acceptance is not position; Gate_Open is.

owner: Export Device: KIND=relay NAME=Gate_Relay CONTROL=Control allowed OPS=trigger; Set Export Schedule as required.
When the gate position sensor changes → Set Local Boolean ITEM=Gate_Open.
peer: Add the Relay companion; pulse it. Then wait for <Owner>.Gate_Open changed (live) before announcing 'gate open' — never on acceptance.
